text:
### Observed differences

- The dominant difference is a reversal between two mutually exclusive three-activity blocks. In the earlier window, A24, A25 and A26 each appeared in about 80 in 100 traces, while A21, A22 and A23 each appeared in about 19–20 in 100; in the later window the shares are reversed, with A24/A25/A26 at about 21 in 100 and A21/A22/A23 at about 79–80 in 100. [OCC004, OCC005, OCC006, OCC007, OCC008, OCC009]
- Each block runs all-or-nothing: pairs inside A24/A25/A26 co-occurred in about 82 in 100 traces before and in about 21 in 100 after, matching those activities' participation; pairs inside A21/A22/A23 rose from about 18–19 in 100 to about 79 in 100. Within both blocks the activities appear in both orders in similar shares, so neither block has a fixed internal order in either window. [REL017, REL018, REL025, REL038, REL039, REL043]
- The blocks remain alternatives: pairs with one activity from each block co-occur in only about 1 in 100 traces in both windows. Before, the old-block activity ran without the new-block activity in about 80 in 100 traces; in the later window the new-block activity runs without the old-block activity in about 78–79 in 100. [REL019, REL021, REL026, REL027, REL028, REL032, REL034]
- A20 precedes whichever block runs, and A20 itself still occurs in essentially every trace. A20 followed by A24/A25/A26 fell from about 81 in 100 traces to about 21 in 100, and A20 followed by A21/A22/A23 rose from about 18–19 in 100 to about 77–79 in 100; of A20's observed outgoing transitions, about 82 in 100 led to A24/A25/A26 before, and about 78 in 100 lead to A21/A22/A23 in the later window. [DIR005, REL011, REL012, REL013, REL014, REL015, REL016]
- A separate rerouting around A06: A06 appeared in about 46 in 100 traces before and about 12 in 100 after. Of A34's observed outgoing transitions, about 45 in 100 previously went to A06 and about 55 in 100 to A35; in the later window about 90 in 100 go to A35 and about 2 in 100 to A06, and A34 is immediately followed by A35 in about 92 in 100 cases (about 56 in 100 before). A06's median relative position moved from about 0.95 to about 0.45 of the trace, though only about 24 after-window traces contain A06. [DIR006, LAG006, OCC003, POS001, REL009]
- Smaller changes: A02 and A04 participation rose from about 8 and 5 in 100 traces to about 17 and 18 in 100; A08's outgoing mix changed on only about 9 before and 23 after traces; several lag items on pairs with A06, A25 or A26 rest on 1–7 after-window observations. [DIR002, LAG001, LAG002, LAG003, LAG004, OCC001, OCC002]

### Inference

Support level: Supported hypothesis

The evidence supports the possibility that two alternative branches after A20 swapped execution shares: in the earlier window about 80 in 100 cases ran the block A24–A26 (all three together, after A20) and about 19 in 100 ran A21–A23, while in the later window about 79 in 100 run A21–A23 and about 21 in 100 still run A24–A26. Both blocks are well observed in both windows, they never run together (co-occurrence about 1 in 100 in both windows), and only the shares between these existing alternatives shifted. Participation counts, within-block co-occurrence, cross-block relations and A20's outgoing mix all change in the same direction, and the volume of qualifying items (73 against roughly 1 expected if nothing had changed, with every item's difference exceeding about 199 of 200 random re-splits) makes chance sampling implausible as an explanation of the set as a whole. Limitations: most items describe this one swap and are not independent confirmations, and the evidence cannot show whether individual cases re-routed or the mix of case types differed between the windows. [DIR005, OCC004, OCC005, OCC006, OCC007, OCC008, OCC009, REL013, REL016, REL018, REL019, REL032, REL043]

Other differences:
- A06 is now largely bypassed on the A34 path: A34 leads to A35 in about 90 in 100 of its outgoing transitions (immediately consecutive in about 92 in 100), where it previously split between A35 and A06, and A06's participation fell from about 46 to 12 in 100 traces. [DIR006, LAG006, OCC003, POS001, REL009]
- A02 and A04 occur in more traces in the later window (about 17 and 18 in 100, up from about 8 and 5), on modest support. [OCC001, OCC002]
- A08's outgoing transition mix changed, but the underlying observations are few (about 9 before, 23 after). [DIR002]
